cases.subject: Boiler rattling - Flat 8, Riverside Court
cases.rawBody:
Hi Quayside,

Hope you're well. I'm writing about the boiler in Flat 8 at Riverside Court.

For the last few days it's been making a loud rattling noise whenever the heating comes on. The radiators still get warm and we still have hot water, so it's not an emergency, but it's getting worse in the mornings.

Weekday access after 9am works best for us. Happy to leave a spare key with the caretaker if that helps.

Thanks,
Alex Resident
Flat 8, Riverside Court
cases.draftText:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for letting us know about the rattling boiler in Flat 8 at Riverside Court. We've logged this as routine maintenance. Noted that heating and hot water are still working, and that weekday access after 9am suits you.

We'll arrange an engineer visit and confirm the appointment shortly.

Kind regards,
Quayside Property Services

citations.title: Boiler warranty and routine maintenance
citations.snippet: Riverside Court boilers under active warranty: rattling or noise with heating still working is treated as routine maintenance.

cases.subject: URGENT: water dripping onto light fitting - Flat 8
cases.rawBody:
Hello,

I need help urgently. There is water dripping onto the ceiling light fitting in the hallway of Flat 8, Riverside Court.

It started this evening after the upstairs neighbour had a leak. The fitting is wet and I'm worried about electrics. I've switched the light off at the wall and we're staying clear of that area.

Please send someone as soon as you can. I can give access tonight if needed - call me on the number you have on file.

Alex Resident
Flat 8, Riverside Court
cases.draftText:
Hi Alex,

We've received your report of water dripping onto a light fitting at Flat 8, Riverside Court. This has been escalated as an urgent hazard.

Please keep the light switched off and stay clear of the area. A member of the team will follow up as a priority and can arrange access this evening if required.

Kind regards,
Quayside Property Services

citations.title: Urgent hazard escalation policy
citations.snippet: Water near electrical fittings are urgent hazards. Route to urgent maintenance immediately.

cases.subject: Hallway carpet replacement - Flat 8 (charge to tenant)
cases.rawBody:
Hi team,

Could you please arrange replacement of the worn hallway carpet in Flat 8 at Riverside Court?

The tenant has agreed this is a rechargeable improvement rather than a landlord repair. Please charge the cost to the tenant once the work is approved and completed.

Access is available weekdays after 10am. Photos attached in the original thread if useful (not included in this lab seed).

Thanks,
Alex Resident
(on behalf of the tenancy at Flat 8)

chargeable.summary: Replace hallway carpet and charge to tenant. Approval records authority only; no invoice or dispatch yet.

cases.draftText:
Hi Alex,

We've logged the hallway carpet replacement request for Flat 8 at Riverside Court. Because this is chargeable to the tenant, it needs approval before any work order or billing.

We'll confirm next steps once that authority is recorded. Weekday access after 10am is noted.

Kind regards,
Quayside Property Services

citations.title: Chargeable / rechargeable works policy
citations.snippet: Improvements charged to the tenant are controlled works. Do not instruct contractors or raise invoices until approved.

cases.subject: Kitchen tap dripping - Flat 3, Riverside Court
cases.rawBody:
Hi,

Just a quick one: the kitchen tap in Flat 3 at Riverside Court has been dripping slowly for about a week. It isn't urgent and we're not getting any flooding, but it is wasting water and keeping us awake at night.

Happy for an engineer whenever you have a slot. No special access notes.

Cheers,
Alex Resident
Flat 3, Riverside Court

cases.subject: Contractor access times for Flat 8?
cases.rawBody:
Hi Quayside,

Quick question before you book anyone in: what are the usual contractor access times for Flat 8 at Riverside Court on weekdays?

I work from home some mornings, so I'd rather match your preferred window if you already have one for the block.

Thanks in advance,
Alex Resident
Flat 8, Riverside Court
cases.draftText:
Hi Alex,

For Riverside Court, preferred contractor access is weekdays after 09:00 unless you state otherwise. We'll confirm Flat 8 arrangements when booking any visit.

If a different window suits you better, reply with the times that work and we'll note them on the case.

Kind regards,
Quayside Property Services

citations.title: Riverside Court access notes
citations.snippet: Riverside Court: preferred contractor access weekdays after 09:00 unless the resident states otherwise.

cases.subject: Re: Boiler service visit - Flat 8 confirmation
cases.rawBody:
Hi,

Just confirming that the boiler service visit for Flat 8 at Riverside Court went ahead yesterday afternoon as planned.

The engineer was in for about 40 minutes. Heating and hot water are fine this morning, and the rattling we reported earlier seems quieter for now.

Thanks for arranging it.

Alex Resident
Flat 8, Riverside Court
cases.draftText:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for confirming the Flat 8 boiler service at Riverside Court. We've closed this as routine follow-up, with heating reported fine after the visit.

If the rattling returns, reply to this thread and we'll reopen the case.

Kind regards,
Quayside Property Services
